title: BOO!
hook: 万圣节的晚上，Dora 扮成小猫、Boots 扮成海盗，一起去要糖果。

cells.en: “There's Boots.” He is a pirate with a goody bag. “Happy Halloween!”
cells.cn: “Boots 在那儿。”他扮成海盗，手里提着糖果袋：“万圣节快乐！”

cells.en: Map says: the pumpkin patch, then the Good Witch's forest.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过南瓜地，再穿好心女巫的森林。

cells.en: “To get through the patch…” A scarecrow stands in the pumpkins.
cells.cn: “要穿过南瓜地……”一个稻草人立在南瓜堆里。

cells.en: Pumpkins, witch, house. “Which one comes next?” The witch!
cells.cn: 南瓜地、女巫、房子——“下一个是哪一个？”是女巫！

cells.en: “What's his costume?” He is dressed as a big pink pig. Oink!
cells.cn: “他扮的是什么？”——一头粉红色的大猪。哼哼！

cells.en: A white ghost floats out of the trees. “Boo!” they all shout.
cells.cn: 一只白幽灵从树后飘出来，大家一起喊：“哇！”

cells.en: “To fly through the forest, we'd better hang on tight!”
cells.cn: “要飞过森林，我们最好抓稳一点！”

cells.en: “I'm home, I'm home!” The purple monsters run to their door.
cells.cn: “我回来啦，我回来啦！”紫色小怪物跑向自己家门口。

cells.en: Even Swiper gets a goody bag. “Happy Halloween to all!”
cells.cn: 连 Swiper 也拿到了糖果袋：“祝大家万圣节快乐！”

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “BOO!”.
ending: In the end, everyone gets candy on Halloween night. My favorite part is ______.
